messages:
max: Heads-up — brought up quantized model on staging (llama-2-13b q4_0 via our quantizer) and seeing premature streaming termination. It often ends after 1-2 EOS-like tokens. Repro steps below, logs attached. @julia any idea?

julia: Can you paste the converter output (config.json + special_tokens_map) and the streaming log snippet? My first guess is special_tokens mapping or a chat template mismatch.

max: Pasting minimal artifacts:
```json
// converted/config.json (trimmed)
{
  "model_type": "llama",
  "eos_token_id": 1,
  "bos_token_id": 0,
  "pad_token_id": -1,
  "tie_word_embeddings": true
}
```
```json
// special_tokens_map.json
{
  "eos_token": "",
  "additional_special_tokens": ["<|assistant|>", "<|user|>"],
  "unk_token": null
}
```
Streaming log snippet (staging):
```
[stream] token ids: 423, 10234, 1, 1, 1
[stream] decoded chunk: "Thanks for that." + "" + ""
[runtime] received EOS sentinel id=1, invoking end-of-stream handler
[runtime] flushing buffer, dropping queued chunks
```
This happens only on q4 quantized build. FP16 baseline produces full stream.

sam: Interesting. So the tokenizer is emitting repeated EOS ids (1,1,1) and our runtime treats the first as terminal and flushes everything else. Two possibilities: 1) converter collapsed multiple HF eos-like markers into a single id but quantization changed embedding/table indices so nearby token ids now map to EOS after compression; 2) streaming handler has a safety that treats consecutive identical EOS IDs as immediate finalization (race with async buffers). Does this repro with CPU fallback or on non-batched requests?

max: Repro is deterministic on batched streaming. On single-request CPU fallback we still see it intermittently. Not present on non-quantized build. Also saw slightly different tokenizer offsets when running tokenizer on CPU vs GPU libs (tok offsets shift by +1 in some calls).

julia: Steps to debug quickly: 1) dump raw tokenizer ids pre- and post-convert (use --dump-token-ids). 2) instrument streaming path to log "seen repeated eos run-length" and do NOT flush on first EOS until we confirm next token. 3) try conservative converter mapping: keep HF's special_tokens_map entries intact (don't coalesce eos alt tokens).

Command I recommend:
```
REDWOOD_DEBUG=tokenizer,stream \
./bin/redwood-infer --model /staging/models/llama-13b-q4 --prompt-file repro.txt --dump-token-ids > /tmp/q4-eos-debug.log
```
Also try toggling converter flag `--preserve-special-tokens=true`.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy: enabled token-debug-logging on staging at 2035012399 (token-debug-logging=true).

max: Running now, will attach the dumps. Thanks — will try --preserve-special-tokens and report. :rocket:
